rals.ham: Nobody saw Marek Ham arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-F14, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Marek Ham is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Marek Ham washed his face and was asked whether headquarters was visiting. Apparently cleanliness requires an explanation.

On a quiet night Marek Ham (Concord) and Edmund Matteozrybak (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. Marek Ham walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Shell splinters peppered R-F14. Marek Ham picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Marek Ham is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home found Marek Ham before the night shift. Marek Ham folded it small and kept it close.
Marek Ham lost a boot to the mud at R-F14. It took two men and a rifle sling to get it back. The mud kept the sock.
toastybweady: Felix "Spark" Toastybweady reported to S-F18 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Felix "Spark" Toastybweady asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Felix "Spark" Toastybweady. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Felix "Spark" Toastybweady gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
